text:
Whilst it’s very uncomfortable at the start (i think we’ve all been there), It’s sooooooo important to build your speaking ability and understanding of speech up (personally i think it’s by far the most important aspect rather than reading or writing). 
I really recommend talking to your partner for as much as you feel comfortable each day (important to practice a little everyday). I also insisted that my partner always correct when i make even little mistakes to not build bad habits. 

Something that sounds funny but is very helpful is to role play speaking situations  in hebrew, like buying something in the shop, or going to the bank etc. Once you build the confidence to speak Hebrew in public to strangers and openly make mistakes, your progress might  increase a lot! Good luck!
